notes.title: Update 1.5.3 is here!
notes.notes:
[h1][u][b]What can you expect in 1.5.3?[/b][/u][/h1]

[b]A New level added:[/b]
in order to better flush out the story off DOMUS ABSCONDITA we added a new level, between level 1 and 2.
For a better experience, and if you have a save file on the first level, we advice to start a new save in order to full experience this update.

[b]Ambience light rework:[/b]
We strive to create an homogeneous experience for all player, and the light is a major part of DOMUS ABSCONDITA, in order to tackle different monitor and PC specs we reworked some parts of the ambience lighting user experience should be more alike between users.

[b]Major sound effects adjustments:[/b]
We added more sound effects, more background and ambience music, we hope you like it.

[b]Major and minor Level redecorations:[/b]
All level got some redecoration, some are minor other are major redecorations.

[b]Some minor bugs were corrected:[/b]
Ambience Sounds missing.
Real time shadows performance adjustments.
UI flicker.
Save data adjustments.
Collisions missing.


[b]We hope you enjoy![/b]
